_comment: Chapter 4 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F17, the comic payoff of Sir Wobbles' thread: the Slime King freed; "Sir Leo of the Bucket".

text.zh_TW: 一隻戴著小王冠的巨大史萊姆被鍊子綁成了一顆粽子。「嗚嗚……寡人……寡人好癢……」
text.en: A huge slime in a tiny crown is tied up in chains like a parcel. "Boo-hoo... We are... We are so ticklish..."

text.zh_TW: 史萊姆王：「放肆！……不過，寡人的果凍是全國最好吃的。」皮普的聲音從某處傳來：「成交！」
text.en: Slime King: "Impudent! ...However, the royal jelly is the finest in the land." Pip's voice calls from somewhere: "Deal!"

text.zh_TW: 「陛下——！」晃晃爵士頂著水桶衝進來，哭得整個身體都在晃。他轉向你，用水桶碰了碰你的肩膀：「吾以水桶之名，冊封你為——水桶騎士里歐！」
text.en: "Your Majesty—!" Sir Wobbles bursts in, bucket on, wobbling with tears. He turns to you and taps your shoulder with his bucket. "In the name of the Bucket, I dub thee... Sir Leo of the Bucket!"
